ProbabilityTheory.entropy_add_right.statement: Let $G$ be a countable additive group in which singletons are measurable, let $\mu$ be a measure on $\Omega$, and let $X, Y : \Omega \to G$ be measurable random variables. Then $H[(X, X+Y);\mu] = H[(X, Y);\mu]$.

ProbabilityTheory.entropy_add_left.statement: Let $G$ be a countable additive group in which singletons are measurable, let $\mu$ be a measure on $\Omega$, and let $X, Y : \Omega \to G$ be measurable random variables. Then $H[(Y+X, Y);\mu] = H[(X, Y);\mu]$.
